# Paid template library references

Created with the built-in imagegen tool before implementation.

- [Desktop dark library](library-desktop-dark.png)
- [Mobile light library](library-mobile-light.png)

## Design extraction

Preserve the app’s Plus Jakarta Sans typography, violet actions, existing header, and shared theme tokens. Use a single flat list with neutral dividers and 16px corners. Each desktop row has a two-line name/subject summary and trailing actions, with 44px touch targets. At narrow widths, move actions beneath the summary so names remain readable. Truncate long summaries; show the full text in the expandable preview. Keep only one preview open and limit its height to 320px with keyboard scrolling.

The library has a labeled server-side search across name and subject, 10 rows per page, result counts, pagination, and useful empty states. New/Edit opens the existing editor separately and preserves search/page context when returning. Free and ungated behavior stay intact. The loading skeleton follows the Paid library layout.

Each template also has a corner-arrow expand icon. It opens that individual message in a larger native dialog, with a readable subject, scrollable message, Edit and Download actions, and a Collapse control. Esc closes the view and returns focus to its expand icon. The underlying search, page, and inline preview stay in place.

The expand icon has an outlined 44px button and an “Expand” tooltip on hover or keyboard focus. Opening uses a 260ms eased fade and scale; closing uses a 180ms exit and waits before hiding the dialog or navigating to Edit. The backdrop fades with the dialog, interrupted opening starts closing from its current position, and repeated close clicks are ignored. Reduced-motion preferences disable these animations.

## Desktop prompt

Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a high fidelity desktop UI reference of Mailloop PAID user's Templates library. This is a compact library for many templates, NOT a full message per card. Existing visual language Plus Jakarta Sans, dark background #0b0a14, flat surface #15132a, foreground #ece9ff, readable muted #b1adc9, violet #a58aff. Header wordmark mailloop and navigation Compose Templates Contacts History Usage Settings; Templates active. Modest left heading 'Templates', subtitle 'Find the right message for your next introduction.' Primary violet 'New template' button at top right. Below one wide search field labeled 'Search templates', placeholder 'Search by name or subject', with Search button. Library toolbar 'Saved templates' and '24 templates'. A single bordered flat list, not separate cards. Show six compact rows about 68px tall. Each row left: small chevron and title on first line, muted subject on second line; right: Edit text link, download icon, Delete text button. Example rows 'First introduction' / 'Exploring {{role}} opportunities at {{company}}'; 'Follow-up' / 'Following up on my application'; 'Referral request' / 'A quick introduction'; 'Portfolio introduction'; 'Recruiter outreach'; 'Thank you'. One row 'Follow-up' expanded to show a short plain message in a shared open detail area immediately below its own row; all other message bodies hidden. Quiet neutral row dividers, 14px text, 16px panel corners, no nested cards, no huge panels, no extra plan upsell for Paid. Below list 'Page 1 of 3 · 24 results' and Previous/Next controls. Keep spacious gutters and readable content with efficient row density. Do not show the template editing form on this library view.

## Mobile prompt

Use case: ui-mockup. Fresh standalone mobile reference for Mailloop Paid Templates library, a compact searchable list to manage many email templates. 430px wide layout displayed at large readable size in 1024x1536 portrait, no phone or browser frame. LIGHT theme #f6f5fb background, white list surface, dark #17142b text, readable muted #6b6788, restrained violet #6d4aff. Plus Jakarta Sans. Header 'Templates' with subtitle 'Find the right message for your next introduction.' Clear 'New template' button beneath aligned left. Label 'Search templates' and search input with Search submit button. 'Saved templates' heading and '24 templates' count. One single flat bordered list with four compact entries, not separate cards. Each entry has a left disclosure chevron, a name and one muted subject line ellipsized, followed by a small action row with Edit, Download JSON icon button with clear icon, Delete. Titles First introduction, Follow-up, Referral request, Portfolio introduction. Message bodies are collapsed. Use thin quiet dividers and touch targets at least 44px high. Avoid huge card gaps, disabled controls, plan upgrade pitches, excessive icons, and showing full messages for every entry. At bottom show 'Page 1 of 3 · 24 results' and 'Next' button. Focus on readable responsive list controls and compactness.
